title: Avoid evaluate_function success-path name allocation
description: Classify supported scalar function names with direct ObjectNamePart matching before dispatch.

criteria: Supported scalar function dispatch no longer builds an uppercase function-name String
Qualified names remain rejected by the simple built-in function check
Vector distance and embedding regressions pass

notes: The function evaluator now dispatches on a small enum derived from direct ObjectNamePart comparisons.
Supported function success paths avoid ObjectName display formatting and uppercase String allocation.
The unsupported-function error path still formats an uppercase name to preserve the previous error text.
